description: Move effect reservation, attempt, completion, permanent failure, lookup, and counts into a focused Ecto context. Use immediate transactions and database constraints to preserve idempotency under concurrency. Add a direct concurrent reservation test before removing the Store GenServer from the supervision tree. Preserve deterministic record keys, reconciliation, receipt reuse, legal transitions, and dependency injection used by protocol tests. Acceptance: concurrent callers obtain one effect identity; duplicate external writes remain impossible; effect recovery tests pass; no state-free Store process remains.
title: Extract effect persistence and retire the Store process
